issue_asks: Support [[Page Name|link text]] rendering as a link with the given text
Link target/class must be identical to [[Page Name]] (base_url, end_url, html_class, custom build_url, wiki_* meta overrides)
Whitespace around name and text is ignored
Empty text part falls back to the page name

findings.problem: Link text cannot contain `[` or `]`, so `[[Page|see [docs]]]` is not recognized. This is documented in docs/extensions/wikilinks.md, and the issue's examples don't need it.

commands_run: python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .  (1177 tests, OK, 52 skipped)
input.summary: The change is correct and minimal. It extends the regex with an optional `|text` group and uses the stripped text, falling back to the page name when the text is empty. The URL is still built from the page name only, so base_url, end_url, html_class, a custom build_url and the meta overrides all behave as for plain links. The full suite passes. My probes showed that whitespace is stripped, an empty or whitespace-only text part falls back to the page name, and plain links are unchanged. Multiple pipes, newlines and brackets in the text leave the input as-is. Inline markup in the text is rendered like normal link text. The only limitation is that link text cannot contain `[` or `]`, which the docs state. The new tests check the behaviour the issue asks for, and no existing tests were changed.
